title: Associate Designer Hardgoods
note: Outdoor hard goods; asks for 1–3 years of experience and relocation to Maine.

facts.summary: Associate designer for L.L.Bean hardgoods: hunt/fish gear, outdoor equipment, luggage and bags.
facts.duties: Sketches, renderings, tech packs in Illustrator and FlexPLM, color-ups, and lab dip and sample approvals.
facts.requirements: BA/BS, 1–3 years of hardgoods experience, Adobe Suite, and FlexPLM, CLO and Mural.
